declarations.name: Lemma E1. Exact tripod coordinates
declarations.scope: For a five-cycle finite factor and two3cycles in the minimal polynomial domain, contracting the five cycles gives exactly two tripods sharing one cycle. With cycle labels, simultaneous-relabeling classes are (c,a,b,d,e;delta), count24N. Forgetting repeated-length labels is the free product-of-symmetric-groups quotient of order M=product m_a!. Every tuple has trivial deck centralizer.

declarations.name: Theorem E2. Two components exactly for distinct lengths
declarations.scope: For every nonidentity five-part cycle type lambda, the full polynomial passport lambda,3,3 has exactly two components if lambda has distinct parts and one otherwise. Pair twists normalize every attachment offset, and the zero-offset moves generate A5 on the five labels. Each strict component has36N absolute/36N^2 literal states. With repeated parts the sole component has72N/M absolute/72N^2/M literal states, except lambda=(1,1,1,1,3) with all three factors of the same type, whose counts are7/49. These are written all-degree proofs, not extrapolated searches.

declarations.name: Theorem E3. Actual group, every block system, and deck symmetry
declarations.scope: For the entire five-cycle/two3cycle family, D=gcd(lambda), n=N/D>=5, all block-count divisors are div(D) union{N}, and every tuple has the identical actual embedded group (product of Alt(B_j))<P_N>. Its order is(n!/2)^D times D for odd n and2D for even n. The normal closure of the literal3cycles is precisely the independent alternating product. Deck group is trivial. D1 specializes to primitive An for odd N and Sn for even N.
